text:
### Key Functions  
#### AML/KYC Compliance
- Customer Due Diligence (CDD) — initial verification at account opening
- Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) — for higher-risk customers
- Ongoing Monitoring — transaction pattern analysis
- Customer Screening — sanctions list, PEP screening  
**See:** AML Policy (AML-POL-002), KYC SOP (KYC-SOP-001)
name: Chunk 37/102

raw_entities.name: Customer Due Diligence
raw_entities.description: Initial identity and address verification process performed at account opening to establish customer identity and assess risk profile. Forms the foundational KYC obligation under AML/KYC compliance framework.
context: Customer Due Diligence (CDD) — initial verification at account opening

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Due Diligence
raw_entities.description: Heightened verification and monitoring procedures applied to higher-risk customers to mitigate elevated AML/CFT exposure. Includes deeper investigation of customer background, source of funds, and beneficial ownership.
context: Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) — for higher-risk customers

raw_entities.name: Ongoing Monitoring
raw_entities.description: Continuous analysis of customer transaction patterns and account activity to detect suspicious behavior, unusual transactions, or deviations from established customer profile. Part of ongoing AML compliance obligations.

raw_entities.name: Customer Screening
raw_entities.description: Systematic checking of customer identity against sanctions lists and Politically Exposed Person (PEP) registers to identify and prevent engagement with sanctioned entities or high-risk individuals.
context: Customer Screening — sanctions list, PEP screening

raw_entities.name: AML Policy
raw_entities.description: Formal policy document (reference AML-POL-002) governing Anti-Money Laundering compliance requirements, procedures, and controls across the organization.

raw_entities.name: KYC Standard Operating Procedure
raw_entities.description: Formal procedure document (reference KYC-SOP-001) detailing the operational steps, controls, and governance for Know Your Customer verification processes across account opening and ongoing monitoring.
